description_en: Queries the details about the accounts that are created on an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的账号信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-accounts --db-instance-id rm-bp1v6z81ho9000000 --account-name zhttest --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

This parameter is not supported for RDS instances that run SQL Server 2017 on RDS Cluster Edition
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取。
暂不支持SQL Server 2017集群系列实例
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 200. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30~200。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码。默认值：1。取值为大于0且不超过Integer的最大值
parameters.name: page_number
